test_cases.title: Start of Mission in Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Perform Start of Mission procedure in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Mode change to be reported to RBC triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up. A mode change occurs that requires reporting to the RBC (not End of Mission).

steps.action: Execute a mode change that must be reported to the RBC in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 1. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of announced radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A radio hole has been announced. The engine rear end is approaching the end of the radio hole. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Move the train so that the engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Previous session terminated due to loss of safe radio connection triggers new session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A communication session was previously established but is considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait for the condition where the previous session is considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Driver manually selecting RBC contact information outside Start of Mission triggers session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Outside Start of Mission procedure. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Successful session establishment sequence
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection is successfully set up.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an Initiation of communication session message.

steps.action: Receive a system version message from trackside that is compatible.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session established and sends a session established report.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible system version
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment and successfully set up safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an Initiation of communication session message.

steps.action: Receive a system version message from trackside that is not compatible.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a 'No compatible version supported' message, informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Retry on safe radio connection failure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Start of Mission procedure is in progress. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment during Start of Mission.
steps.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection set-up fails.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately repeats the request for safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver has not elected single-radio mode. An order from trackside to establish a session with an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only is received.

steps.action: Receive order from trackside to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection using the FRMCS radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. During Start of Mission, driver elected to perform mission with only GSM-R. No trackside order specifying radio system is present.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment (e.g., via mode change report).
steps.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection using the GSM-R radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored Radio Network information
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver has not elected single-radio mode. No trackside order specifying radio system. Preferred radio system from previous session is FRMCS.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: The OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection using the FRMCS radio system (preferred from previous session).

test_cases.title: Memorisation of radio system used for successful connection
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. No previous preferred radio system stored.

steps.action: Establish a communication session using the GSM-R radio system successfully.
steps.expected: The OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on desk closure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Start of Mission procedure is in progress. Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested but system version not yet received).

steps.action: Driver closes the desk during Start of Mission while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested but system version not yet received).

steps.action: Perform End of Mission while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested but system version not yet received).

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to terminate the communication session while establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on passing Level 2 exit border
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested but system version not yet received). Train is approaching a level transition border from Level 2 to an area where Level 2 is not supported.

steps.action: Train passes with its min safe rear end the level transition border from Level 2 to a non-Level 2 area while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact info when order contains 'last known RBC' identity
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. RBC contact information is stored on board. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with the RBC, where the RBC identity value is the special 'last known RBC' value and a telephone number is provided in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU disregards the telephone number in the order and contacts the RBC using its stored RBC contact information.

test_cases.title: Ignore order for 'last known RBC' when no contact info is stored
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No RBC contact information is stored on board. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with the RBC, where the RBC identity value is the special 'last known RBC' value.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with the same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, Start of Mission is completed, and a communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (safe radio connection requested but not yet confirmed).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of receiving a second trigger for session establishment while the first is in progress.

steps.action: Trigger a second session establishment request with the same RBC-A (e.g., via a mode change that requires reporting to the RBC) while the first session establishment is still in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate communication session establishment process with RBC-A. It continues the existing establishment process or ignores the redundant trigger.

test_cases.title: Prevention of new session while an active session exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a stable communication session with RBC-A is established. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The driver can manually select RBC contact information outside of Start of Mission.

steps.action: The driver manually selects RBC contact information for RBC-A (the same RBC with which the session is currently active) outside of the Start of Mission procedure.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active and uninterrupted.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing a new one with a different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A is established. The train is approaching a border where a transition to RBC-B is announced.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to handle only one communication session at a time (or the specific scenario requires termination per §3.5.3.5.2).

steps.action: The OBU receives an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B (a different RBC) via a balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RBC-A (sends Termination of Communication Session) and initiates the establishment of a new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC order does not terminate current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or the specific exception applies.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC transition order includes an embedded order to establish a session with an Accepting RBC (RBC-B).

steps.action: The OBU receives an RBC transition order that includes an embedded order to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A. It proceeds to establish the session with RBC-B while maintaining the connection with RBC-A (if supported) or handles the transition without premature termination of the supervising RBC session.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. The train is oriented in the nominal direction. A balise group is passed in the reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group contains information valid only for the reverse direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: The train passes a balise group in the reverse direction while in SL mode. The balise contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account, as it is valid for the crossing direction (reverse), despite the train's nominal orientation.

test_cases.title: Ignoring information valid for opposite direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. The train is oriented in the nominal direction. A balise group is passed in the nominal direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group contains information valid only for the reverse direction.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group in the nominal direction while in SH mode. The balise contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information, as it is valid only for the opposite direction to the crossing direction (nominal).

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if time condition is met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, session established. MA request parameters are currently active with a repetition period of 10 seconds. The last MA request was sent 12 seconds ago.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC sends new MA request parameters with a repetition period of 10 seconds.

steps.action: The OBU receives new MA request parameters from the RBC. The time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than or equal to the newly received repetition period (10s).
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC immediately upon receiving the new parameters.

test_cases.title: No immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if time condition is not met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, session established. MA request parameters are currently active. The last MA request was sent 5 seconds ago.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC sends new MA request parameters with a repetition period of 10 seconds.

steps.action: The OBU receives new MA request parameters from the RBC. The time since the last MA request (5s) is less than the newly received repetition period (10s).
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request immediately. It waits until the repetition period (10s) has elapsed since the last MA request before sending the next one.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while LOA is supervised
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. The MA includes an End Section and an Overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the LOA end.

steps.action: The train approaches the end of the Overlap and the Danger Point while the LOA is still being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. The end of the Overlap, Danger Point, and end of the End Section are not used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid until new one is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is received and active.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving in Level 1.

steps.action: The train continues to move in Level 1 without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: A new signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is received.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 50 km/h restriction with the 80 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid after switch to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with an active signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h. The train is transitioning to Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: The Level 2 MA has not yet been accepted by the OBU.

steps.action: The OBU switches from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The 50 km/h signalling related speed restriction remains valid and is applied by the OBU.

steps.action: The OBU accepts a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (or is replaced by the Level 2 MA constraints, as per normal Level 2 operation).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a normal operating mode. The train's actual maximum speed is configured to 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: No other speed restrictions are active that are lower than 200 km/h.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the permitted speed for the train.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Maximum Train Speed (200 km/h) as a Static Speed Restriction (SSR) category, limiting the permitted speed to 200 km/h.

test_cases.title: Initial state for permitted braking distance speed restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a normal operating mode. No permitted braking distance (PBD) data has been received from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the permitted speed for the train.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply any speed restriction based on permitted braking distance. The 'no speed restriction' state is active for PBD.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for permitted braking distance speed restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a normal operating mode. A PBD speed restriction of 100 km/h is currently active based on previously received data.
test_cases.assumptions: Trackside sends an order to resume the initial state for PBD.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to resume the initial state for permitted braking distance speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU removes the 100 km/h PBD speed restriction. No PBD limit constrains the train speed thereafter.

test_cases.title: Immediate re-establishment attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the trackside. The safe radio connection is active and was set up via a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R).

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection by having EURORADIO indicate the loss.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Observe the radio system used for the new connection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the same radio system through which the safe radio connection was previously set up successfully.

test_cases.title: Repeated attempts until safe radio connection is re-established
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection again.

steps.action: Allow the third re-establishment attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts as the safe radio connection is obtained.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when session is considered terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for considering the session terminated (per Appendix A.3.1) is known and can be monitored.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination is short enough to be observed in the test environment.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Ensure all re-establishment attempts fail and wait until the defined time for session termination elapses.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated and stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with an RIU. The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU has received an RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train to the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection as the train has passed the termination location.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode (e.g., FS). No internal termination condition is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to terminate the communication session (e.g., via RBC message).

steps.action: The OBU receives an explicit order from the trackside (RBC) to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger an internal condition requiring termination (e.g., loss of safe radio connection or specific mode change defined in SUBSET-026).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is one of those defined in SUBSET-026 that requires termination without an explicit trackside order.

steps.action: An internal condition requiring termination of the communication session is fulfilled (e.g., safe radio connection lost).
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message, even though no explicit trackside order was received.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a stable supervised mode. No trackside order is received and no internal termination condition is active.

steps.action: Wait for a period longer than the fixed waiting time without receiving any trackside order or triggering any internal termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains established.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time defined in Appendix A.3.1 without receiving an acknowledgement from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the 'Termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acknowledgement of termination from RBC.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: The RBC sends an acknowledgement of the termination within the fixed waiting time.
steps.expected: The OBU does not repeat the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The RBC does not send any acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N (from Appendix A.3.1). The fixed waiting time is T.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message (1st time).
steps.expected: Message sent.

steps.action: Wait for time T. No acknowledgement received. The OBU repeats the message (2nd time).
steps.expected: Message repeated.

steps.action: Continue this process until the defined number of repetitions (N) is reached. Wait for time T after the last sending (Nth time). No acknowledgement received.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated. No further 'Termination of communication session' messages are sent.

test_cases.title: Session not considered terminated if acknowledgement received after last repetition
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The RBC does not send acknowledgement for the first N-1 repetitions.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acknowledgement of termination from RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message N times, waiting the fixed time between each, with no acknowledgement for the first N-1 times.
steps.expected: The OBU has sent the message N times.

steps.action: The RBC sends an acknowledgement within the fixed waiting time after the Nth (last) sending.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the session terminated solely based on the timeout logic of ETC-014 (it follows the normal termination flow upon receiving acknowledgement). The session state is updated to terminated/terminating as per standard acknowledgement handling, not the 'no reply' fallback.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and available. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored (either memorised or default).

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a stable state. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: The driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but is not currently registered to the GSM-R Radio Network specified in the trackside order. No communication session is established and no safe radio connection is being set up.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network type (GSM-R or FRMCS+GSM-R) and identity.

steps.action: The OBU receives a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the Radio Network type and orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no memorised Radio Network type (e.g., after a System Failure or at the very first power-up). A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power up the OBU or trigger a System Failure recovery where no Radio Network type is memorised.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: Only FRMCS on-board equipment is installed (no GSM-R). The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is duly registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected single radio system not registered
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board is no longer registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: Only GSM-R is installed (no FRMCS). The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU session when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: GSM-R is installed. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status upon successful safe radio connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The driver is at the desk. The indication status is currently 'No Connection'. The GSM-R mobile terminal is registered to the network.

steps.action: The OBU successfully establishes a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC (Condition [4] from Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Up' and displays this status to the driver.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' after timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The driver is at the desk. The indication status is currently 'No Connection'. The OBU has sent a request to set up a safe radio connection and the 'connection status' timer is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer value is known from Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the 'connection status' timer to expire without a successful safe radio connection being established (Condition [2] from Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' and displays this status to the driver.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer upon first request for session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. No safe radio connection is established. The indication status is 'No Connection'.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the 'connection status' timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Trigger a session establishment event (e.g., Start of Mission or mode change) that causes the OBU to send the first request to set up a safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer upon first request for session maintenance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A communication session is established but the safe radio connection is lost. The OBU is attempting to re-establish the safe radio connection to maintain the session.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the 'connection status' timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Observe the OBU sending the first request to set up a safe radio connection to maintain the existing session after a loss.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending this first request.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The Start of Mission procedure is ongoing. The indication status is 'No Connection'. The OBU is attempting to set up a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Ensure the final attempt to set up the safe radio connection fails while the Start of Mission procedure is still ongoing (Condition [1] from Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Up'. The safe radio connection is established.

steps.action: Cause the safe radio connection to be lost (e.g., by moving out of coverage or simulating a radio failure) while the requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [6] from Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection' upon stopping requests
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'. No Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: Stop the requests to set up a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC/RIU for a reason other than successful set-up (e.g., End of Mission or driver action) (Condition [3] from Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of safe radio connection status for current RIU infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. The train is within a radio infill area. The OBU has a safe radio connection with the RIU of the current infill area. The indication status is 'Connection Up'.

steps.action: Verify the indication status displayed to the driver while the train is in the current infill area with an active safe radio connection to the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the safe radio connection status relating to the RIU of the current infill area (e.g., 'Connection Up').

test_cases.title: Indication update when train moves to a new RIU infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. The train is moving from one radio infill area to another. The OBU has safe radio connections with both the previous and the new RIU.

steps.action: Move the train such that it enters a new radio infill area, making the new RIU the 'current infill area'.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the indication to reflect the safe radio connection status relating to the new current infill area's RIU.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing LRBG with invalid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An LRBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid' and an invalid position value is stored on-board.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'invalid' and the stored position is marked as invalid.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on-board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing ORBG with unknown position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'unknown'. An ORBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'unknown'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on-board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A is active. The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab B was the last active cab. Both cabs are now inactive.

steps.action: Deactivate all cabs so that no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that no cab is active.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation based on the last active cab (Cab B), i.e., the side of Cab B is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for supervising location based information
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where location based information is supervised (e.g., Full Supervision). The estimated front end position is known and distinct from the max safe front end and min safe rear end.

steps.action: Configure a location based event (e.g., a speed restriction start) at a specific distance from the estimated front end.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated front end position as the reference for calculating the distance to the event.

steps.action: Move the train towards the event.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the supervision action (e.g., speed limit application) when the estimated front end reaches the event location, not when the max safe front end or min safe rear end reaches it.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start location
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where the End Section timer is active. The start location of the End Section is defined. The max safe front end is distinct from the estimated front end.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end reaches the start location of the End Section, while the estimated front end is still behind it.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer when the max safe front end passes the start location, as specified for this function.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBG and acceptance of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Train has passed a balise group (BG1) that is marked as linked and contained in the previously received linking information. Linking consistency is checked on-board. The OBU has reported BG1 to the RBC as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG1. The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG1 as the LRBGONB.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information (e.g., MA or profile) that refers to BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information and processes it correctly.

test_cases.title: Position reporting when linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency is NOT checked on-board. Train has passed a balise group (BG2) that is not marked as unlinked. The OBU has reported BG2 to the RBC as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG2. The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG2 as the LRBGONB, as it is not marked as unlinked.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside data referring to the 8th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, ..., BG8. BG8 is the most recent LRBGONB. The RBC is configured to use one of the previously reported LRBGs as reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8, as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG1 (the 8th last reported LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information, as BG1 is within the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside data referring to the 9th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, ..., BG9. BG9 is the most recent LRBGONB. The RBC is configured to use one of the previously reported LRBGs as reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8, as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG1 (the 9th last reported LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU does not accept the information, as BG1 is outside the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with 'unknown' LRBG when position is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The train position is unknown (e.g., after a SoM procedure where position data was deleted). The OBU has not passed an LRBG compliant balise group since the position became unknown.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains an LRBG identifier set to 'unknown'.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to a specific balise group (e.g., BG1).
steps.expected: The OBU does not accept the information as valid for position referencing, or handles it according to the 'unknown' position exception rules (typically rejecting or ignoring location-dependent data until a valid LRBG is passed).

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a known train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed in the direction corresponding to the train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group transmitting data identified as valid for the nominal direction while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account and applies the data (e.g., updates location or profile).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information not valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a known train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed in the direction corresponding to the train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data identified as valid for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group transmitting data identified as valid for the reverse direction only while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information and does not apply the data.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). The train passes a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for one direction only (nominal).

steps.action: The train passes a balise group transmitting data valid for one direction only (nominal) while the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid for both directions when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). The train passes a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group transmitting data valid for both directions while the train orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data and takes it into account.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value validity and incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data. A new continuous profile data message is received from a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with values V1, V2 and distances D1, D2. D1 is the distance from the balise to the start of V1 validity. D2 is the distance from the start of V1 to the start of V2.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data with values V1, V2 and distances D1, D2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets V1 as valid for the distance D2 (from the start of V1 to the start of V2) and V2 as valid for the following distance.

steps.action: The OBU checks the validity of the data for the first distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data for the distance D1 (from the balise to the start of V1).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: last value validity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives a continuous profile data message with a last value that is not an end-of-profile value.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with a last value Vn that is not an end-of-profile value.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data where the last value Vn is not an end-of-profile value.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Vn as valid for an unlimited distance.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: zero distance handling
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives a continuous profile data message where a distance is zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with a value Vn followed by a distance Dn+1 = 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data where the distance following value Vn is zero.
steps.expected: The OBU still takes value Vn into account.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: incremental distances and previous data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data. A new location data message is received from a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with values L1, L2 and distances D1, D2. D1 is the distance from the balise to the start of L1 validity. D2 is the distance from the start of L1 to the start of L2.

steps.action: The OBU receives location data with values L1, L2 and distances D1, D2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the distances as unsigned incremental values between consecutive values.

steps.action: The OBU checks the validity of the data for the first distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data for the distance D1.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: element starts and overlaps
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data. A new non-continuous profile data message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with elements E1 (length L1), E2 (length L2) and distances D1, D2. D1 is the distance from the balise to the start of E1. D2 is the distance from the start of E1 to the start of E2. D2 < L1 (elements overlap).

steps.action: The OBU receives non-continuous profile data with elements E1, E2 and distances D1, D2 where D2 < L1.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the start of E2 as being at distance D2 from the start of E1, and accepts that the elements overlap.

steps.action: The OBU checks the validity of the data for the first distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (or initial data/default values) for the distance D1.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: distances and values
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives linking information from a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with announced balise groups BG1, BG2 and distances D1, D2. D1 is the distance from the current balise to BG1. D2 is the distance from BG1 to BG2.

steps.action: The OBU receives linking information with announced balise groups BG1, BG2 and distances D1, D2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets D1 as the distance to the first announced balise group BG1 and D2 as the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: The OBU checks the values associated with the announced balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets each value as the linking data of the corresponding balise group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information containing a specific location accuracy value for Balise Group BG1 is stored. The train is approaching BG1.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy value provided in the linking information for BG1.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG2 is available. A National Value for location accuracy is defined and applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value for the location accuracy of BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG3 is available. No National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG3, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of BG3.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 has become LRBG and its location accuracy was determined from linking information (Value A). New linking information is received that specifies a different location accuracy (Value B) for BG1.

steps.action: The OBU processes the new linking information.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A and is not updated to Value B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking check stops
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 has become LRBG and its location accuracy was determined (Value A). The system state changes such that linking consistency is no longer checked.

steps.action: The OBU continues operation with linking consistency not checked.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values apply
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 has become LRBG and its location accuracy was determined (Value A). The train moves into an area where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.

steps.action: The OBU operates in the area with the new National Value.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A and is not updated to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving. The reference balise group has a known location accuracy. The over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. The train is not in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end. The distances are composed of the location accuracy of the reference balise group and the over-/under-reading amounts. The consist length uncertainty is not included.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. The reference balise group has a known location accuracy. The over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. The consist length uncertainty is known.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end. The distances are composed of the location accuracy of the reference balise group, the over-/under-reading amounts, and the consist length uncertainty.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored. The train passes Balise Group BG1, which is the reference of the linking information.

steps.action: The train passes BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU sets BG1 as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. The train passes Balise Group BG2.

steps.action: The train passes BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU sets BG2 as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives new linking information that changes the reference balise group for the SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for other information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information (not linking information) referred to a balise group different from the current SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information that, according to SUBSET-026 Table 2a, is associated with a specific type of location item (e.g., 'min').

steps.action: The OBU processes the location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into up to three location items ('min', 'estimated', 'max') and applies the clause associated with the 'min' location item for that information.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current SOLR. Location based information is referred to BG1. The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the new SOLR. Linking information is available and known for the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: The train passes BG2, making it the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates every location item to BG2 by subtracting the distance between BG1 and BG2 (retrieved from linking information) from the distance to BG1. For 'min' items, the distance is diminished by twice the location accuracy of BG1; for 'max' items, it is augmented by twice the location accuracy of BG1.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current SOLR. Location based information is referred to BG1. The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the new SOLR. Linking information is not available or known for the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: The train passes BG2, making it the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates every location item to BG2 by subtracting the estimated, min, or max travelled distance between BG1 and BG2 (computed from train front end positions) from the distance to BG1.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train moving, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train decelerates and reaches standstill (speed 0 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train at standstill, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train accelerates from standstill to a speed greater than 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by mode change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode.

steps.action: A mode change occurs (e.g., from FS to SB due to a brake application).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: The train level changes (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by driver confirming train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., via external source or driver action).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established, RBC contact information available.

steps.action: A communication session with the RBC is successfully established.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, no position report parameters stored on-board.

steps.action: The train passes an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end passes an RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by RBC/RBC border crossing (max safe front end)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train's max safe front end passes an RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level transition border (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching a level transition border leading to Level 0, NTC or 1.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end passes a level transition border which led to a transition from level 2 to level 0, NTC or 1.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by error detection
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: An error as defined in 3.16.4 is detected.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'No integrity information' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Lost' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Initial integrity status after session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established.

steps.action: A communication session with an RBC is successfully established.
steps.expected: The train integrity status information to be reported to this RBC is set to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: An external source confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: The conditions for transition to 'No integrity information' are met (e.g., new session or specific reset condition per Table 2c).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored (e.g., from a recent balise group). The train is moving. The geographical position display is currently not active.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position display is currently active on the DMI.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received geographical position information from a balise group. The track kilometre reference is known. The train is moving in the direction of increasing track kilometre.
test_cases.assumptions: The offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference is 0 m for simplicity, or a known constant value. The odometer is functioning correctly.

steps.action: The train passes the geographical reference balise group. The OBU stores the track kilometre reference value (e.g., TK 100.000).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the initial geographical position based on the track kilometre reference and the offset.

steps.action: The train travels a known distance (e.g., 100 m) away from the reference balise group in the direction of the track kilometre counting direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the geographical position by adding the distance travelled (100 m) to the initial track kilometre reference value. The displayed or internal position reflects the sum of the reference value, offset, and distance travelled.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill in a mode where Roll Away Protection is active (e.g., FS or OS). The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The train position is not referenced to a balise group (e.g., after a power cycle or in a section without balises).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the internal 'remaining distance' variable for verification purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll Away Protection supervision (e.g., by entering a standstill state that triggers it).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as 10 m (the full National Value), as the estimated distance travelled away from the start location is 0.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 8 m (10 m - 2 m).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance to run in SR mode is set to 500 m (via RBC or Driver input). The train position is not referenced to a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the internal 'remaining distance' variable for verification purposes.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a defined maximum distance of 500 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as 500 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 400 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of roll-away distance using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection is active with a maximum distance of 10 m. The train is at the start location of the supervision.
test_cases.assumptions: Odometer reading is accurate and matches the actual distance travelled.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises the distance based on the estimated distance travelled (5 m). The remaining distance is 5 m. No safety reaction is triggered.

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 5 m (total 10 m).
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the estimated distance travelled (10 m) has reached the supervised limit. A safety reaction (e.g., brake application) is triggered.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Post Trip reversing distance
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Post Trip (PT) mode. The maximum distance for reversing is set to 20 m. The train is at the start location of the reversing supervision.
test_cases.assumptions: Odometer reading is accurate.

steps.action: Reverse the train by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises the reversing distance based on the estimated distance travelled (10 m). The remaining distance is 10 m. No safety reaction is triggered.

steps.action: Reverse the train by another 10 m (total 20 m).
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the estimated distance travelled (20 m) has reached the supervised limit. A safety reaction is triggered.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position for Staff Responsible distance with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode with a maximum distance of 100 m. The odometer has a known under-reading of 5 m (i.e., the odometer reads 5 m less than the actual distance travelled). The train is at the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured with the odometer under-reading value of 5 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward such that the odometer reads 95 m (actual distance travelled is 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position. The max safe front end is ahead of the estimated front end by the under-reading amount (5 m). The remaining distance from the max safe front end to the end of the supervised distance is 100 m - 95 m - 5 m = 0 m. The OBU triggers a safety reaction because the max safe front end has reached the limit.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position for Staff Responsible distance with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode with a maximum distance of 100 m. The odometer has a known over-reading of 5 m (i.e., the odometer reads 5 m more than the actual distance travelled). The train is at the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured with the odometer over-reading value of 5 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward such that the odometer reads 105 m (actual distance travelled is 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end position. The min safe front end is behind the estimated front end by the over-reading amount (5 m). The remaining distance from the min safe front end to the end of the supervised distance is 100 m - 105 m + 5 m = 0 m. The OBU triggers a safety reaction because the min safe front end has reached the limit.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position for zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Stand By (SB) or Post Trip (PT) mode. Override function has been triggered. There is no valid train position stored on-board. The zero distance to the former EOA/LOA is supervised.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to supervise a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated front end position. The remaining distance is 0 m - 1 m = -1 m. The OBU triggers a safety reaction because the estimated front end has passed the zero distance limit.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Non-infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A valid MA is received via RBC. The MA is a non-infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) end before the Supervised Location (SvL) of the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with EOA at 1000m, SvL at 1000m. SSP/Gradient data valid only up to 800m from train front.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive an MA where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid and supervision continues based on the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or 2, train in FS mode. An infill MA is received via balise. The MA is an infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) end before the Supervised Location (SvL) of the MA, starting from the infill location reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with infill reference at 0m, EOA at 500m, SvL at 500m. SSP/Gradient data valid only up to 300m from the infill reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as at least from the infill location reference to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the infill location reference to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid and supervision continues based on the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Supervised Manoeuvre, opposite orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A Supervised Manoeuvre MA is received. The validity direction of the MA is opposite to the current train orientation. The SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated front end of the train (derived from the new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre MA with opposite orientation. New train front end estimated at 0m (relative to new orientation). SvL at 200m. SSP/Gradient data valid only up to 100m from the new front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for this case is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre MA with opposite validity direction where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated train front end (new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the associated mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid and supervision continues based on the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance when SSP/gradient covers full length (Non-infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A valid MA is received via RBC. The MA is a non-infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) cover the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with EOA at 1000m, SvL at 1000m. SSP/Gradient data valid up to 1200m from train front.

steps.action: Receive an MA where the SSP and gradient data cover the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location.
